mapper.select: SELECT s.group_roster_visible_to_members, s.version, s.updated_at, u.display_name AS updated_by_display_name FROM event_participant_settings s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.updated_by WHERE s.space_id = #{spaceId} AND s.event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_participant_settings ( space_id, event_id, group_roster_visible_to_members, version, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{rosterVisible}, 1, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (space_id, event_id) DO NOTHING
